# @stackline/parse-link-header

Maintained, zero-runtime-dependency continuation of parse-link-header@2.0.0.

Install:

    npm install @stackline/parse-link-header

No-source-change migration:

    npm install parse-link-header@npm:@stackline/parse-link-header

Supports callable CommonJS, default and named ESM, browser bundles, TypeScript
3.9+, and Node.js 12-24. The relation-keyed pagination output and the default
2,000-character CVE-2021-23490 mitigation are preserved.

Canonical docs: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/parse-link-header/
Source: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-parse-link-header
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stackline/parse-link-header
